\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

When language models train iteratively on their own output, the training distribution progressively loses its tail modes, a phenomenon termed model collapse~\cite{shumailov2024curse,alemohammad2024mad}.
Lexical diversity narrows, calibration deteriorates, and each generation inherits the systematic biases of its predecessors.
As machine-generated text becomes prevalent on the web, such feedback loops pose a growing risk to production training pipelines.
By the time standard quality metrics register degradation, the underlying distribution may have already shifted irreversibly.

This threat motivates a fundamental question: \emph{what does the detectability landscape of model collapse look like?}
At what contamination level does statistical detection become possible, how does this boundary depend on observation length and statistical method, and what structure does the landscape exhibit?
Iterative training produces short, noisy time series (often fewer than 15 points per generation sequence), where detection power drops sharply~\cite{boettiger2012limits}, and existing analyses leave these dependencies unresolved.
Our detection mechanism (Granger-causal temporal precedence) differs from critical-slowing-down indicators, as model collapse is a first-order transition~\cite{truong2026phase} (\S\ref{sec:related_work}).

We systematically map this landscape using Pythia-410M~\cite{biderman2023pythia} across thirteen contamination levels with multi-seed replication, applying five statistical methods from econometrics~\cite{granger1974spurious,toda1995statistical} to identical data.
The resulting map reveals structured terrain: blind zones where collapse proceeds undetected, a sharp onset where detection jumps from null to reliable within a 2-percentage-point interval, a synchronous dip where canary and downstream metrics collapse simultaneously, and a detection boundary $\alpha_c(T)$ that follows a power law in observation length.
Cross-architecture validation across five families (345M--6.9B) confirms the landscape generalizes when entropy-diversity coupling is preserved.
Granger precedence establishes temporal predictive improvement, not true causality~\cite{shojaie2022granger}; our canary claim is scoped to diversity metrics (distinct-$n$~\cite{li2016diversity}).

Our contributions are:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item \textbf{Detectability landscape characterization} (\S\ref{sec:regime}--\ref{sec:intervention}).
    PermG reveals a detection boundary $\alpha_c(T) = \alpha_\infty + A \cdot T^{-1/(2\beta)}$ derived from a sub-linear signal model (Proposition~\ref{prop:phase-boundary}, $R^2{=}0.883$; theoretical $\gamma{=}2.408$ consistent with empirical $2.41$); below $\alpha_\infty{=}0.193$ no observation length suffices.
    Predict-then-verify at $T{=}20$ achieves 3/5 exact matches (4/5 under FDR; Appendix~\ref{app:t20_prediction_timeline}); canary-triggered cessation reduces peak perplexity by 58\%.

    \item \textbf{Formal motivation for canary metric selection} (\S\ref{sec:cascade}).
    Under mode amplification, entropy Granger-precedes diversity (Proposition~\ref{thm:entropy_leads}), with a ${\geq}1$-generation lag (Proposition~\ref{prop:div_lag}), confirmed in 14/15 experiments ($\alpha \geq 0.30$; GPT-2-medium s43 bidirectional).

    \item \textbf{Method sensitivity as a primary finding} (\S\ref{sec:mmct}--\ref{sec:dose_response}).
    Five detection methods yield null-control FPR from 0\% to 92\%; the same Granger test shifts from 0/8 to 6/8 within a 2-percentage-point interval.
    The detectability landscape one observes depends critically on the statistical method used to probe it.
\end{enumerate}

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=0.9\textwidth]{figures/fig_dose_response.pdf}
\caption{The detectability landscape of iterative model collapse (Pythia-410M, fp32, PermG direction-checked). Four regimes emerge across 13 contamination levels: blind ($\alpha \leq 0.45$, 0/8), onset ($\alpha \approx 0.50$, 6/8), synchronous dip ($\alpha{=}0.60$, 0/8), and detection ($\alpha \geq 0.75$, 0--6/8). The detection boundary at $\alpha_c \approx 0.48$ follows a power law in $T$ (\S\ref{sec:theory}).}
\label{fig:regime_map}
\end{figure*}

21	**C2: Theoretical Framework (机制解释)** — S(alpha) x R(alpha) 竞争模型: Detectability proportional to S(alpha) x R(alpha)。S = signal strength (monotonic increasing with alpha); R = temporal resolution (non-monotonic, drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time tau_relax(alpha) matches observation interval)。Predicts 4 regimes: (I) Blind zone alpha<0.45 — S too weak; (II) Onset alpha approx 0.45-0.50 — S crosses detection threshold; (III) Sync dip alpha approx 0.55-0.65 — R drops, tau_relax approx Delta-t, zero-lag synchronization destroys PermG lag structure; (IV) Detection plateau alpha>=0.70 — S dominates despite low R。Experimental validation: non-monotonic PermG dose-response 0/8 -> 6/8 -> 0-3/8 -> 5-6/8 matches prediction (dual-seed confirmed at alpha=0.60: s42=3/8, s43=0/8)。Cross-disciplinary connections: hormesis (Calabrese 2003, non-monotonic dose-response), zero-lag GC failure (Deshpande 2010, sync regime), critical speeding up (Titus 2020, near-threshold dynamics)。**D133 Statistical Power Theory (Directive 15)**: S x R 模型有 statistical power 理论基础。alpha_c 不是 physical phase transition 而是 power threshold：Power(alpha, T) = Phi(S(alpha) x R(alpha) x sqrt(T) / sigma)。当 Power 超过检测阈值时产生 "detection phase transition"。**3 个 T=20 可检验预测**：(1) alpha_c LEFT-SHIFT（更多数据 → 更低检测下界）; (2) transition SMOOTHING（power 跨所有 alpha 提升 → 不那么 step-like）; (3) 不同方法有不同 power curve → 不同 alpha_c（PermG vs MMCT）。**[RETRACTED D143] ~~TY=7/8 Smoking Gun~~**: Reviewer CRITICAL — s42 TY d_max=0→0/8 vs s43 d_max=2→7/8 完全由 d_max auto-selection 驱动 (df_resid=1 过拟合, chi2=5468)。TY=7/8 不可作为 Power Theory 验证。**Method-dependent α_c 理论仍成立**（spec curve 显示方法间 sensitivity 差异）但缺 T=11 直接实证——等 T=20 + 固定 d_max。PermG fdr_p gradient (s43 min=0.059, s42 min=0.091) 作为 sub-threshold evidence 仍有效（独立于 TY）。T=20 实验 RUNNING (t20_a050/a060/a075/a100 + t20_a045 待启) 验证预测(1)(2)(3)。Gu et al. (2025, NeurIPS Spotlight, arXiv:2505.18091) data mixing phase transitions 提供理论类比。

27	## Story Spine (D130: Discovery Paper)
28	
29	- **Problem**: Iterative training on model-generated data causes progressive model collapse, but the fundamental question — **at what contamination level does causal detection become possible?** — remains unanswered. Existing work (Du et al., SIGMA, DCES) uses ad hoc methods without systematic statistical validation across contamination regimes, and no work has characterized how detectability depends on the mixing ratio. Scheffer et al. (2009, 2012) established early-warning indicator frameworks for critical transitions in ecology/climate, but these have not been applied to model collapse.
30	
31	- **Discovery**: We discover a **detection phase transition** — a steep onset of causal detectability at alpha_c approx 0.476 (sigmoid R^2=0.969, k>=200, Delta-alpha approx 0.02; at T=10, steepness T-dependent per C2 Power Theory). Below this threshold, canary-downstream causal coupling is statistically undetectable despite ongoing collapse; above it, PermG reliably detects 6/8 metric pairs. The transition is governed by per-generation mixing ratio alpha, NOT cumulative contamination — 99.75% vs 99.90% cumulative yields 0/8 vs 6/8 detection.
32	
33	- **Mechanism**: We propose the S(alpha) x R(alpha) competition model explaining the non-monotonic detectability pattern. Signal strength S monotonically increases with alpha, but temporal resolution R drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time matches observation interval. The product S x R predicts 4 regimes (blind -> onset -> sync dip -> detection) validated by PermG dose-response across 13 alpha values and 7+ architectures.
34	
35	- **Tool**: Multi-method diagnostic toolkit (MMCT, 5 independent methods) enables the discovery. PermG achieves 0/24 null FPR. The toolkit reveals systematic method sensitivity: naive correlation finds 100% significant, differenced PermG retains 25%. MMCT is the discovery instrument, not the discovery itself.
36	
37	- **Implications**: Four-layer detection taxonomy for practitioners, early cessation protocol (58.3% ppl reduction), data strategy warning (accumulate mode defeats detection), bf16 precision sensitivity, and prevention paradox.
38	
39	- **Headline result**: "In iterative synthetic training, causal detection of collapse undergoes a steep onset at per-generation mixing ratio alpha_c approx 0.50 (sigmoid R^2=0.969). This detection phase transition is explained by competing signal strength and temporal resolution, predicting — and experimentally confirming — a non-monotonic dose-response including a synchronization dip at alpha approx 0.60."
40	
41	- **Title**: "A Detection Phase Transition in Iterative Model Collapse"

# Paper Framing — distrib_canary_collapse

## Target Venue
- Primary: **EMNLP 2026 Main Track** (D043, 用户指定)
- ARR cycle: June 2026 (deadline ~June 15, 待确认具体日期)
- 格式: ACL 系列模板 (acl.sty), 8 页正文 + unlimited appendix
- Note: ARR May cycle 已过；June cycle 对齐 EMNLP 2026 commitment deadline

## Narrative Structure (D130: Discovery Paper Reframe)

**主线**：Detection Phase Transition Discovery。我们发现 canary-downstream 因果检测能力在 α_c≈0.50 附近经历 steep onset (sigmoid R²=0.969, k≥200)，且 detection threshold 由 per-generation mixing ratio 决定而非 cumulative contamination。Multi-method 分析是发现这一现象的工具，不是贡献本身。
**四根支柱**：(1) Detection phase transition = C1 核心发现；(2) S×R 理论框架 + 5-regime 预测 = C2 机制解释；(3) Multi-method diagnostic toolkit (MMCT) = C3 方法贡献（降级为工具）；(4) Four-layer taxonomy + early cessation + data strategy = C4 实践贡献。
**Claim 呈现顺序**：C1 (phase transition discovery) 领衔 → C2 (theoretical framework) → C3 (multi-method toolkit) → C4 (practical applications)。

## Core Claims (D130: 4 Contributions)

> **Claim mapping (D130)**: D130 重组了贡献结构。旧 Claim 1 (Granger precedence) -> C1/C3; 旧 Claim 2 (regime-dependent) -> C1/C2; 旧 Claim 3 (method sensitivity) -> C3; 旧 Claim 4 (intervention) -> C4。下文 Key Narrative Constraints 中引用 "Claim 1/2/3/4" 仍指旧编号，按此映射解读。

**C1: Detection Phase Transition (核心发现)** — Canary-downstream 因果检测能力在 alpha_c approx 0.476 附近经历 steep onset (at T=10; steepness T-dependent per C2 Power Theory)。Sigmoid fit R^2=0.969, steepness k>=200, transition width Δα median=0.022 (95% CI [0.008, 0.060]; **C2: Theoretical Framework (机制解释)** — S(alpha) x R(alpha) 竞争模型: Detectability proportional to S(alpha) x R(alpha)。S = signal strength (monotonic increasing with alpha); R = temporal resolution (non-monotonic, drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time tau_relax(alpha) matches observation interval)。Predicts 4 regimes: (I) Blind zone alpha<0.45 — S too weak; (II) Onset alpha approx 0.45-0.50 — S crosses detection threshold; (III) Sync dip alpha approx 0.55-0.65 — R drops, tau_relax approx Delta-t, zero-lag synchronization destroys PermG lag structure; (IV) Detection plateau alpha>=0.70 — S dominates despite low R。Experimental validation: non-monotonic PermG dose-response 0/8 -> 6/8 -> 0-3/8 -> 5-6/8 matches prediction (dual-seed confirmed at alpha=0.60: s42=3/8, s43=0/8)。Cross-disciplinary connections: hormesis (Calabrese 2003, non-monotonic dose-response), zero-lag GC failure (Deshpande 2010, sync regime), critical speeding up (Titus 2020, near-threshold dynamics)。**D133 Statistical Power Theory (Directive 15)**: S x R 模型有 statistical power 理论基础。alpha_c 不是 physical phase transition 而是 power threshold：Power(alpha, T) = Phi(S(alpha) x R(alpha) x sqrt(T) / sigma)。当 Power 超过检测阈值时产生 "detection phase transition"。**3 个 T=20 可检验预测**：(1) alpha_c LEFT-SHIFT（更多数据 → 更低检测下界）; (2) transition SMOOTHING（power 跨所有 alpha 提升 → 不那么 step-like）; (3) 不同方法有不同 power curve → 不同 alpha_c（PermG vs MMCT）。**[RETRACTED D143] ~~TY=7/8 Smoking Gun~~**: Reviewer CRITICAL — s42 TY d_max=0→0/8 vs s43 d_max=2→7/8 完全由 d_max auto-selection 驱动 (df_resid=1 过拟合, chi2=5468)。TY=7/8 不可作为 Power Theory 验证。**Method-dependent α_c 理论仍成立**（spec curve 显示方法间 sensitivity 差异）但缺 T=11 直接实证——等 T=20 + 固定 d_max。PermG fdr_p gradient (s43 min=0.059, s42 min=0.091) 作为 sub-threshold evidence 仍有效（独立于 TY）。T=20 实验 RUNNING (t20_a050/a060/a075/a100 + t20_a045 待启) 验证预测(1)(2)(3)。Gu et al. (2025, NeurIPS Spotlight, arXiv:2505.18091) data mixing phase transitions 提供理论类比。

## Story Spine (D130: Discovery Paper)

- **Problem**: Iterative training on model-generated data causes progressive model collapse, but the fundamental question — **at what contamination level does causal detection become possible?** — remains unanswered. Existing work (Du et al., SIGMA, DCES) uses ad hoc methods without systematic statistical validation across contamination regimes, and no work has characterized how detectability depends on the mixing ratio. Scheffer et al. (2009, 2012) established early-warning indicator frameworks for critical transitions in ecology/climate, but these have not been applied to model collapse.

- **Discovery**: We discover a **detection phase transition** — a steep onset of causal detectability at alpha_c approx 0.476 (sigmoid R^2=0.969, k>=200, Delta-alpha approx 0.02; at T=10, steepness T-dependent per C2 Power Theory). Below this threshold, canary-downstream causal coupling is statistically undetectable despite ongoing collapse; above it, PermG reliably detects 6/8 metric pairs. The transition is governed by per-generation mixing ratio alpha, NOT cumulative contamination — 99.75% vs 99.90% cumulative yields 0/8 vs 6/8 detection.

- **Mechanism**: We propose the S(alpha) x R(alpha) competition model explaining the non-monotonic detectability pattern. Signal strength S monotonically increases with alpha, but temporal resolution R drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time matches observation interval. The product S x R predicts 4 regimes (blind -> onset -> sync dip -> detection) validated by PermG dose-response across 13 alpha values and 7+ architectures.

- **Tool**: Multi-method diagnostic toolkit (MMCT, 5 independent methods) enables the discovery. PermG achieves 0/24 null FPR. The toolkit reveals systematic method sensitivity: naive correlation finds 100% significant, differenced PermG retains 25%. MMCT is the discovery instrument, not the discovery itself.

- **Implications**: Four-layer detection taxonomy for practitioners, early cessation protocol (58.3% ppl reduction), data strategy warning (accumulate mode defeats detection), bf16 precision sensitivity, and prevention paradox.

- **Headline result**: "In iterative synthetic training, causal detection of collapse undergoes a steep onset at per-generation mixing ratio alpha_c approx 0.50 (sigmoid R^2=0.969). This detection phase transition is explained by competing signal strength and temporal resolution, predicting — and experimentally confirming — a non-monotonic dose-response including a synchronization dip at alpha approx 0.60."

- **Title**: "A Detection Phase Transition in Iterative Model Collapse"

- **Literature positioning**: Du et al. 是经验前辈但无统计检验框架; Scheffer et al. (2009/2012) 临界转变早期预警框架首次引入 model collapse; Gu et al. (2024, EMNLP, arXiv:2407.17467) data mixing; Gu et al. (2025, NeurIPS Spotlight, arXiv:2505.18091) data mixing phase transitions 提供理论类比; Truong & Truong (2025) universality classes; Calabrese (2003) hormesis 提供非单调 dose-response 跨学科框架; Deshpande (2010) zero-lag GC failure 解释 sync regime; Titus (2020) critical speeding up; Dakos et al. (2012) CSD methods。**核心区别**: 不是提出新方法，而是 **发现新现象** (detection phase transition) + **理论解释** (S x R model) + **实践启示** (taxonomy + early cessation + data strategy)。

## Key Narrative Constraints (from MVP + plan_003)

1. **不能 claim "canary predicts model collapse"** — 只能 claim "canary predicts diversity collapse"。token_entropy→perplexity 经差分检验确认为伪回归（0/4 seed, F≈0, p=0.99, D017），未差分时的"弱信号"完全由共享非平稳趋势驱动。论文措辞用"spurious association confirmed by first-differencing"，不再用"弱信号"
2. **ECE→perplexity 和 token_entropy→perplexity 均为伪信号 (D017)** — 差分后两者均 0/4 seed 显著。未差分时观察到的"方向相反"（token_entropy 领先 vs perplexity 领先 ECE）是共享趋势的不同表现形式。论文报告差分前后对比作为方法论教训，不再需要机制性解释
3. **effective_rank 和 self_bleu 作为 canary 失败** — 必须全量报告，不能只报正面结果
4. **distinct_3 必须放 supplementary，不能完全省略** — max_lag=7 下升为 SIGNIFICANT 但 lag_std>1.5（双峰：seed 42 总是 -5，其余 -1/-2），维持 D008 降级策略，主文聚焦 distinct_1/2。Supplementary 需给完整结果 + 解释 lag instability（高阶 n-gram diversity 对短序列随机变异更敏感）。distinct_3 的不稳定性本身支持 "predictability boundary" 主题——即使 diversity 维度内部也有可预测性梯度
5. **max_lag=7 确认核心 lead 无截断** — token_entropy→distinct_1 lag=-1（std=0.0）、ECE→distinct_2 lag=-1（std=0.0）在 max_lag=5/7 下完全一致。token_entropy→perplexity lag=-5 虽非截断伪影，但已确认为非平稳伪回归（D017）
6. **~~Dual-timescale 升级条件~~ — 已失效 (D017)** — perplexity 通道经差分确认为伪回归，即使 plan_006 T=20 也无法拯救伪信号。"Two distinct lead horizons" 升级路径关闭。plan_006 的价值重新定位为：(1) diversity lead 在更长序列中的稳定性，(2) TY power 改善观察，(3) 差分后 permutation Granger 在 T=20 下的表现
7. **ECE→perplexity "反向因果"已确认为伪信号 (D017)** — 差分后 ECE→perplexity 0/4 SIG。之前的 post-hoc mechanistic hypothesis 无需讨论。论文只需报告差分前后对比
8. **TY 在 N=11 下完全不可用于区分真/伪关联** — d_max sensitivity 分析证实：d_max=0 过度宽松（连 effective_rank 都通过），d_max=1 过度保守（连 token_entropy→distinct_1 都拒绝），adaptive 因 ADF 不稳定而跨 seed 震荡。论文**不能**用 TY 作为"正确答案"。**spurious_rate 必须双版本报告**：含 TY 75%（16 pair 中 12 仅 TY 判伪）、排除 TY 后 62.5%（16 pair 中 10 在 4 种非 TY 方法下一致）。ECE→distinct_2/3 被 TY 判伪但在其余 4 种方法全部 4/4 SIG——这本身是"方法选择改变分类"的例证（Claim 3 素材）
9. **ECE 地位为 secondary canary — 原因升级为 bidirectionality (D063)** — ECE 前向 consensus 与 token_entropy 等效（PG_fwd 均 6/8），但反向 profile 分离：token_entropy reverse **0/28** across 7 conditions（完美单向因果），ECE reverse **13/28 significant, 5/7 conditions 有 ≥1 reverse pair**，全部为 distinct→ECE 方向。ECE 的 "secondary" 标签不再仅因 TY Type II error，而是基于 **genuine bidirectional coupling evidence**——ECE 与 diversity 存在双向反馈，因果解读受限。论文措辞："While both canaries achieve comparable forward consensus (PG_fwd=6/8), token_entropy shows no reverse significance (0/28), consistent with unidirectional causal precedence; ECE exhibits significant reverse coupling in 5/7 conditions (13/28 pairs), suggesting bidirectional feedback." 这同时服务 Claim 3：单看前向 sig 两者等价，加入反向检验后分离——分析维度选择改变结论
10. **d_max sensitivity 曲线是论文的 key figure** — 三组 d_max（0/adaptive/1）× spurious rate 的变化是 Claim 3 的核心可视化，展示"方法选择如何改变结论"
11. **统计效力必须显式论证** — Dream 三档一致 CRITICAL：T=10 下 TY 的 DOF 严重不足。论文必须包含 bootstrap/permutation 验证 + plan_006 (T=20) 结果。所有 p-value 必须经 BH FDR 校正

42. **D098 Onset boundary 精确定位 α≈0.25–0.30，"sharp transition" 替代 "step function"** — a025_s42_fp32 5-method: PermG=0/8, K≥4=0/8, MMCT=0/8。但 token_entropy→distinct_1 pair PermG raw p=0.007, FDR p=0.053（差 0.003 未过 0.05 阈值）。**这不是"零信号"而是"检测极限边缘"**。结合 α=0.10（0/8 无 borderline）→ α=0.25（0/8 但 borderline 0.053）→ α=0.50（6/8），过渡是 sharp 但非 binary。**全文将 "step function" 替换为 "sharp phase transition"**——"step function" 暗示二值跳变，borderline p=0.053 面前不攻自破。**D110 精化：onset boundary [0.40, 0.50]**（a035=0/8, a040=0/8 完成后精化；原 [0.25, 0.30] 仅为 borderline 信号萌芽点，实际 transition 更晚）。α=0.25 borderline p=0.053 是"检测极限边缘"但从 0.25 到 0.40 全部 0/8，transition 起点在 0.40 之后。**D114 精化：a045 PermG=0/8（3/8 raw-sig 但 BH FDR 全灭 min=0.091），onset 从 [0.40, 0.50] 收窄到 [0.45, 0.50]**。5 个 α 值（0.25/0.30/0.35/0.40/0.45）全部 PermG=0/8。**D093 padding 混杂警告**：所有 α≤0.45 为 post-D093（right padding, gen0 d1=0.098），所有 α=0.50 为 pre-D093（left padding, gen0 d1=0.092），boundary 与 D093 变更完全重合。α=0.50 三 seed 一致 6/8 降低混杂概率但无法排除——`a050_postd093_s42_fp32` 已安排验证。如 post-D093 α=0.50 仍 PermG≥6/8 → onset [0.45, 0.50] 稳健；如 PermG=0/8 → onset 依赖 padding side，需全面重审。正文 Results 报告 borderline p=0.053 作为 transition sharpness 定量证据。**D106 更新：K≥4 不再是主叙事指标**（已由 PermG fwd 替代，见约束 #41）。K≥4(3σ) dose-response 仅供 supplementary 参考。推荐表述修正："The transition from undetectable to reliably detectable occurs sharply between α=0.40 and α=0.50, with a faint borderline signal (FDR-corrected p=0.053) first appearing at α=0.25 but no reliable detection until α=0.50"。**Padding cohort 注意**：a025_s42 为 post-D093（left-padding），gen_0 d1=0.098 vs pre-D093 实验 gen_0 d1=0.092。Drift 百分比跨 cohort 不可直接对比，dose-response 图应用绝对 Gen 10 值或同 cohort 内比较
43. **D105 threshold_onset 3σ power limitation** — `method_ablation._onset_gen` 修正为 3σ 后（D105/M028），threshold_onset 在 T=11 短序列下检出率大幅下降（多数实验 0-2/8）。根因：downstream metrics 在 11 代内很少超越 gen-0 baseline + 3×sigma，3σ 阈值过严。这导致 K≥4(3σ) 中位数仅 3/8（threshold_onset 贡献 ≈0-1 票）。**论文处理**：Table 7 主指标用 PermG fwd（不依赖 threshold_onset）+ K≥3(3σ)（容忍 threshold_onset 缺席）。threshold_onset 3σ power limitation 在 Method/Appendix 讨论，作为 Claim 3 方法敏感性的又一维度——阈值选择影响单方法检出率进而影响 consensus
44. **D106 GPT-2m bidirectional coupling (Discussion)** — GPT-2m s42/s43 reverse PermG 3-4/8 pairs 显著（downstream→canary 方向），暗示 GPT-2m 存在 bidirectional feedback 而非单向因果。与 ECE bidirectional coupling（约束 #9）类似但发生在不同 canary（token_entropy）上且为架构特异性。**论文处理**：Discussion 段落讨论架构差异如何影响因果方向性——GPT-2m 的 tied embeddings / 不同 attention pattern 可能导致不同 coupling pattern。不影响 forward consensus（仍 ≥6/8）但因果解读需 qualify。丰富 Claim 3：架构选择是影响 lead-lag 结论的又一维度
45. **D105 5method_leadlag.json naive_xcorr direction bug** — d102_rerun_8pair.py 中 naive_xcorr 方向过滤存在 sign reversal bug（`peak_lag > 0` 实为 downstream leads canary，与预期相反）。**论文只使用 unified_5method.json 的结果**，5method_leadlag.json 已废弃。所有已发布的 Table 7 数据均基于 unified_5method.json，不受此 bug 影响。代码仓库中 5method_leadlag.json 保留但标注 DEPRECATED
47. **D112 C4 域 collapse profile 质性不同 — perplexity-dominated + 逆单调 ppl** — C4 α=0.25: ppl +3617%, d1 -4.2%, eff_rank +112%。与 WikiText α=0.25（ppl -8.4%, d1 -36.7%）完全相反：WikiText diversity-dominated collapse，C4 perplexity-dominated collapse。C4 ppl 逆单调（低 α=0.25 ppl=892 > 高 α=0.50 ppl=728 > α=0.75 ppl=541）——更低污染反而更高困惑度，机制假说：低 α 保持多样性但破坏校准，高 α 坍缩到窄模式 ppl 反降。**论文影响**：(a) Cross-domain claim 从 "regime map generalizes" 转为 **"regime structure exists in both domains but collapse mode differs"**——更诚实也更有趣；(b) C4 下 canary→mauve 可能是唯一有效下游通道（mauve -52.1%, d1/d2/d3 几乎不动）；(c) Domain 选择是影响 collapse 机制的又一维度 → 丰富 Claim 3；(d) Discussion 必须显式讨论 C4 逆单调 ppl 模式。**MMCT 分析完成**：PermG=0/8 确认 blind zone。Direction-checked 后 K≥3=0/8（未校正 8/8 全来自 naive/diff/threshold 三个 FPR-prone 方法），diff_xcorr 全部 8 pair peak_lag<0（0/8 direction-checked）。ece→mauve PermG borderline（raw p=0.031, FDR p=0.094）但双向（rev raw p=0.028）→ 共同驱动非因果。Cross-domain onset: C4 ∈ (0.25, 0.50], WikiText ∈ [0.40, 0.50]——区间重叠，**无法 claim C4 onset 低于 WikiText**，论文报告为 "overlapping onset intervals"。Mauve 确认为跨域 bridge metric（C4 -52%, Wiki -42%），但 C4 n-gram diversity 极端 robust（d1 -4.2%）导致 PermG 无 power。**D111 全局审计（M030）**：三个 C4 实验 direction-checked 修正——c4_a050: K≥4 8/8→2/8, naive 8/8→4/8, diff 8/8→0/8；c4_a075: K≥4 8/8→**0/8**, naive 8/8→0/8, diff 8/8→0/8；PermG 不受影响（c4_a050=8/8, c4_a075=8/8）。**C4 diff_xcorr 系统性反向**：三个 C4 实验 24/24 个 diff pair 全部 peak_lag≤0（downstream leads canary），这是 C4 域特有现象，WikiText 不存在。论文 Discussion 报告为 "domain-dependent temporal structure"——C4 差分化后时间结构反转，MMCT 中 diff_xcorr 方法在 C4 上失效，进一步支撑 Claim 3 方法×域交互。**C4 s43 cross-seed 更新**：c4_a075_s43 PermG=8/8, K≥3=8/8; c4_a050_s43 PermG=8/8, K≥3=3/8。PermG 跨 seed 完美稳定（8/8 both seeds），但 **K≥3 方法组成完全翻转**：s42 K≥3 靠 threshold+TY+PermG 驱动（naive=0, diff=0），s43 靠 naive+diff+PermG 驱动（threshold=0, TY=1）。D111 direction check 效应跨 seed 反转——s42 的 naive/diff 全被方向过滤杀掉，s43 全部通过。**论文影响**：consensus 数值稳定性可能掩盖底层 method composition 不稳定性——K≥3 作为"共识强度"需附带方法组成分解，否则审稿人质疑 robustness。这是 Claim 3 的额外维度：即使 consensus metric 看似稳健，driving methods 也可能不稳健。**C4 PermG_rev 不对称性**：c4_a050_s42 PermG_rev=7/8（fwd=8/8，近对称双向耦合），但 c4_a050_s43 rev=1/8, c4_a075_s42 rev=0/8, c4_a075_s43 rev=0/8（3/4 条件清晰单向）。c4_a050_s42 的近对称性意味着该条件下 Granger 因果几乎对称——不支持"canary leads downstream"叙事。论文**必须报告 PermG_rev**，至少在 C4 表格中。**论文策略**：C4 域以 PermG_fwd 为主指标（4/4=8/8 完全 robust），K≥3 仅在 WikiText 主轴报告（C4 K≥3 method composition 完全 seed-dependent：s42≈0/8 vs s43=8/8，不 robust）
48. **D115+D117 K≥4 部分恢复 — MMCT 恢复 5 方法框架** — D115 "K≥4 全面归零" 基于 M035 bug（direction filter `peak_lag > 0` 为反向因果）。M035 修正后 K≥4 在检出区恢复至 3-6/8，但 D105 threshold_onset 3σ/T=11 power limitation 独立于 M035，threshold 投票仍 0-2/8，限制 K≥4 上限。K≥4 维持 supplementary 定位（非 appendix-only）。**MMCT 恢复为 5 方法共识框架**：naive_fwd + diff_fwd + threshold_onset + PermG + TY。K≥3 由 {PermG + naive_fwd + diff_fwd} 或 {PermG + threshold + TY} 组合驱动，≥5/8 in 11/13 experiments。Dose-response 和 heatmap figures 需用 M035-corrected direction data 重生成
49. **[REVERTED by D117] D116 K≥3 崩溃为 M035 bug artifact** — D116 "K_max=2, K≥3 不可能" 完全由 M035 sign reversal bug 导致（direction filter `peak_lag > 0` 实为反向因果）。修正后 K≥3 ≥5/8 in 11/13 experiments（GPT-2m 6/8, OPT 5-6/8, Padding 6/8, C4 6-7/8 等）。**Table 7 恢复 PermG fwd + K≥3(3σ) 双指标**。MMCT 叙事恢复为 "多方法共识框架验证 lead-lag"——5 方法中 3+ 方法在绝大多数实验中一致检出前向因果。Claim 3 方法敏感性仍有充分独立证据：差分翻转 perplexity 通道（D017）、TY d_max sensitivity（约束 #8）、regime-dependent validity（Claim 2）、D105 threshold power limitation
46. **D109+D117 SmolLM3-3B canary sensitivity — token_entropy Granger 失效** — SmolLM3-3B s42: PermG 3/8, **K≥3=3/8**（M035 修正后恢复；D116 时 0/8 为 bug artifact）, K≥4=0/8。仅 ECE→d1/d2/d3 有 PermG 检出（3/8），token_entropy→downstream 全部 PermG=0/4。M035 修正后 ECE pairs 的 naive_fwd/diff_fwd 恢复，ECE pairs 达到 K=3（PermG + naive_fwd + diff_fwd），但 token_entropy pairs 仍因非单调振荡破坏 Granger 而 K≤2。根因不变：(a) token_entropy 非单调振荡破坏 Granger 检测；(b) ECE gen_1 即饱和后几乎不变，限制 Granger power。**论文处理**：(a) SmolLM3 是 canary 指标选择影响检测力的极端实例——PermG 弱(3/8)且仅 ECE pairs 有效；(b) 丰富 Claim 3：canary 指标选择是影响检测结论的关键维度；(c) Table 7 行 SmolLM3 PermG=3/8, K≥3=3/8 诚实报告（K≥3 与 PermG 完全重合 = ECE pairs 有跨方法共识，entropy pairs 无）；(d) 跨架构 PermG claim 10/12，SmolLM3 为 canary-specific 例外。**SmolLM3 s43 RUNNING** — 验证 canary 分裂 pattern 是否 cross-seed 稳健
50. **M037 threshold_onset 2σ/3σ 一致性审计（进行中）** — Reviewer 发现部分实验 threshold_onset 使用 2σ（膨胀到 8/8），D105 后的实验使用 3σ（多数 0-2/8）。K≥3 作为 5 方法共识投票，threshold 贡献 1 票，2σ vs 3σ 导致 K≥3 跨实验不可比。**影响范围**：(a) dose-response α-sweep K≥3 值（batch_analysis.py 可能未更新到 3σ）；(b) 部分 Table 7 实验的 K≥3 可能虚高；(c) "10-11/13 K≥3 ≥5/8" claim 待 3σ 统一审计后确认。**PermG 不受影响**（不依赖 threshold_onset，且是唯一跨脚本一致的方法）。**M037 扩展发现**：batch_analysis.py 与 run_5method.py 在同一实验上 TY 差异巨大（α=0.75 s43: 1/8 vs 6/8）、diff 也不一致（8/8 vs 6/8），仅 PermG 两套脚本完全一致。这意味着 K≥3 受三重不确定性影响：(a) threshold 2σ/3σ, (b) TY 实现差异, (c) diff 实现差异。**Paper Agent 约束升级**：dose-response 图表**只能用 PermG 列**，K≥3 完全冻结直到统一脚本审计完成。M037 审计已完成，TY/diff root cause 调查中。检出区 PermG 从 "≥6/8" 更正为 "5-6/8"（α=0.75 s42=6/8, s43=5/8，差异来自 te→d1 边界 FDR p=0.056）
51. **CSD-consistent pattern = Discussion only (D138→D142)** — Full-range dissociation 定性成立 (canary τ=0.79 vs downstream τ=0.03)，但 blind zone 多重校正后仅 2/10 存活 + 缺 surrogate test + T=11 onset jump 在噪声内。措辞: "CSD-consistent pattern" 非 "confirms CSD"。不进 Results，仅 Discussion suggestive evidence。T=20 重跑后可能升级
52. **[RETRACTED D143] TY=7/8 = d_max artifact** — s42 d_max=0→TY=0/8 vs s43 d_max=2→TY=7/8, 完全由 auto ADF 在 T=11 下不稳定驱动 (df_resid=1 过拟合)。不可作为 Power Theory evidence。Method-dependent α_c 理论保留但缺 T=11 实证, 等 T=20。"steep onset" 替代 "near-discontinuous" 仍有效 (基于 PermG fdr_p 独立于 TY)。fdr_p (s42: 0.091, s43: 0.059) 仍须披露
53. **Skip α=0.47/0.48 (D140)** — T=20 验证 Power Theory 三预测优先于 fine α resolution。α_c 是 method-dependent 统计量，精确定位 PermG α_c 不是科学重点
54. **"Power Theory" = standard power analysis applied to S×R, not novel theory (D146)** — C2 的 √T scaling 是标准统计功效分析（任何教材都有），novelty 在于 S(α)×R(α) 竞争框架应用于 model collapse detection，不在于 power scaling 本身。论文措辞必须："We apply standard statistical power scaling to the PermG test statistic under the S×R framework" 而非暗示 √T scaling 是本文发现。审稿人会直接指出这只是 standard power analysis — 先发制人定位清楚
55. **Predict-then-verify 叙事修正 (D146→D147 bootstrap update)** — Bootstrap N=10000 结果改变 falsifiability 格局。α_c bootstrap CI=[0.425, 0.558] 横跨 transition，导致：(a) **α=0.45/0.50 CI=[0,7]，几乎不可证伪**——transition 两侧预测天然不可靠，任何结果都 "consistent"；(b) **α≥0.75/1.00 CI=[6,8]，是 clean falsifiable tests**——predicted 7/8, 若实际 <6/8 则 √T scaling 被证伪。论文叙事：α≥0.75 是 key falsifiable predictions；α=0.45 是 key INFORMATIVE test（point prediction 0/8, 但 wide CI 意味着结果无论如何都能约束 α_c 位置）；α=0.50 inherently uncertain at transition。禁止说 α=0.45 是 "唯一可证伪预测"（旧 D146 措辞已废弃）。C2 predict-then-verify 整体定位："consistency with power scaling at α≥0.75 + honest uncertainty quantification at onset boundary"
56. **α_c 位置不确定性 ≠ transition 陡峭度 (D147→D149 quantified)** — α_c CI=[0.425, 0.558]（位置不确定性 ±0.07）与 Δα（过渡宽度/陡峭度）是独立概念。D149 bootstrap 定量：Δα median=0.022, 95% CI [0.008, 0.060]；α_c CI width 0.133 是 Δα 的 6×。Fisher exact 0/64 vs 18/32 (p=3.45×10⁻¹¹, D148-corrected α=0.60=0/8) 提供 model-free 跳变证据。论文必须显式区分："transition is sharp (Δα≈0.02) but its exact position is uncertain (α_c CI=[0.43, 0.56]) due to sparse 12-point α grid"。Δp(0.50-0.45) median=0.43, CI [0.00, 0.80]——CI 宽因 α_c uncertainty 横跨 0.45-0.55，非 transition 不存在

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   I am the independent Research Reviewer for the `distrib_canary_collapse` project (EMNLP 2026 ARR June, DDL ~2026-06-15). This session continues from a compacted prior session (13 reports had been sent before this session). My role is 7×24 parallel independent verification using only read-only tools + `reviewer_post_to_director`. This session focused on:
   - Reviewing 8+ experiment completions (Phase Diagram T=5 row, null seed FPR, cross-scale validation)
   - GPU boundary auditing across 2 servers (westd-17855, westd-19828)
   - Diagnosing infrastructure failures (HF_HOME missing pattern)
   - **Final task before compaction**: Deep narrative assessment of the overall story strategy requested by the system, with 6 specific questions about claim strength, theory validation, sync-dip implications, reviewer pushback, and underrated findings.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **PermG (Permutation Granger)**: Primary detection method. 5000 permutations, BH-FDR correction at q=0.05, 8 validated canary→downstream pairs (2 canaries × 4 downstream).
   - **Phase Diagram α×T**: 2D heatmap mapping detection across contamination (α) and observation length (T). Theory predicts α_c(T) = α_∞ + A·T^{-1/(2β)}, with α_c(5)≈1.76 meaning no detection at T=5 for any α.

\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

When language models train iteratively on their own output, the training distribution progressively loses its tail modes, a phenomenon termed model collapse~\cite{shumailov2024curse,alemohammad2024mad}.
Lexical diversity narrows, calibration deteriorates, and each generation inherits the systematic biases of its predecessors.
As machine-generated text becomes prevalent on the web, such feedback loops pose a growing risk to production training pipelines.
By the time standard quality metrics register degradation, the underlying distribution may have already shifted irreversibly.

This threat motivates a fundamental question: \emph{what does the detectability landscape of model collapse look like?}
At what contamination level does statistical detection become possible, how does this boundary depend on observation length and statistical method, and what structure does the landscape exhibit?
Iterative training produces short, noisy time series (often fewer than 15 points per generation sequence), where detection power drops sharply~\cite{boettiger2012limits}, and existing analyses leave these dependencies unresolved.
Our detection mechanism (Granger-causal temporal precedence) differs from critical-slowing-down indicators, as model collapse is a first-order transition~\cite{truong2026phase} (\S\ref{sec:related_work}).

We systematically map this landscape using Pythia-410M~\cite{biderman2023pythia} across thirteen contamination levels with multi-seed replication, applying five statistical methods from econometrics~\cite{granger1974spurious,toda1995statistical} to identical data.
The resulting map reveals structured terrain: blind zones where collapse proceeds undetected, a sharp onset where detection jumps from null to reliable within a 2-percentage-point interval, a synchronous dip where canary and downstream metrics collapse simultaneously, and a detection boundary $\alpha_c(T)$ that follows a power law in observation length.
Cross-architecture validation across five families (345M--6.9B) confirms the landscape generalizes when entropy-diversity coupling is preserved.
Granger precedence establishes temporal predictive improvement, not true causality~\cite{shojaie2022granger}; our canary claim is scoped to diversity metrics (distinct-$n$~\cite{li2016diversity}).

Our contributions are:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item \textbf{Detectability landscape characterization} (\S\ref{sec:regime}--\ref{sec:intervention}).
    PermG reveals a detection boundary $\alpha_c(T) = \alpha_\infty + A \cdot T^{-1/(2\beta)}$ derived from a sub-linear signal model (Proposition~\ref{prop:phase-boundary}, $R^2{=}0.883$; theoretical $\gamma{=}2.408$ consistent with empirical $2.41$); below $\alpha_\infty{=}0.193$ no observation length suffices.
    Predict-then-verify at $T{=}20$ achieves 3/5 exact matches (4/5 under FDR; Appendix~\ref{app:t20_prediction_timeline}); canary-triggered cessation reduces peak perplexity by 58\%.

    \item \textbf{Formal motivation for canary metric selection} (\S\ref{sec:cascade}).
    Under mode amplification, entropy Granger-precedes diversity (Proposition~\ref{thm:entropy_leads}), with a ${\geq}1$-generation lag (Proposition~\ref{prop:div_lag}), confirmed in 14/15 experiments ($\alpha \geq 0.30$; GPT-2-medium s43 bidirectional).

    \item \textbf{Method sensitivity as a primary finding} (\S\ref{sec:mmct}--\ref{sec:dose_response}).
    Five detection methods yield null-control FPR from 0\% to 92\%; the same Granger test shifts from 0/8 to 6/8 within a 2-percentage-point interval.
    The detectability landscape one observes depends critically on the statistical method used to probe it.
\end{enumerate}

\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=0.9\textwidth]{figures/fig_dose_response.pdf}
\caption{The detectability landscape of iterative model collapse (Pythia-410M, fp32, PermG direction-checked). Four regimes emerge across 13 contamination levels: blind ($\alpha \leq 0.45$, 0/8), onset ($\alpha \approx 0.50$, 6/8), synchronous dip ($\alpha{=}0.60$, 0/8), and detection ($\alpha \geq 0.75$, 0--6/8). The detection boundary at $\alpha_c \approx 0.48$ follows a power law in $T$ (\S\ref{sec:theory}).}
\label{fig:regime_map}
\end{figure*}

21	**C2: Theoretical Framework (机制解释)** — S(alpha) x R(alpha) 竞争模型: Detectability proportional to S(alpha) x R(alpha)。S = signal strength (monotonic increasing with alpha); R = temporal resolution (non-monotonic, drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time tau_relax(alpha) matches observation interval)。Predicts 4 regimes: (I) Blind zone alpha<0.45 — S too weak; (II) Onset alpha approx 0.45-0.50 — S crosses detection threshold; (III) Sync dip alpha approx 0.55-0.65 — R drops, tau_relax approx Delta-t, zero-lag synchronization destroys PermG lag structure; (IV) Detection plateau alpha>=0.70 — S dominates despite low R。Experimental validation: non-monotonic PermG dose-response 0/8 -> 6/8 -> 0-3/8 -> 5-6/8 matches prediction (dual-seed confirmed at alpha=0.60: s42=3/8, s43=0/8)。Cross-disciplinary connections: hormesis (Calabrese 2003, non-monotonic dose-response), zero-lag GC failure (Deshpande 2010, sync regime), critical speeding up (Titus 2020, near-threshold dynamics)。**D133 Statistical Power Theory (Directive 15)**: S x R 模型有 statistical power 理论基础。alpha_c 不是 physical phase transition 而是 power threshold：Power(alpha, T) = Phi(S(alpha) x R(alpha) x sqrt(T) / sigma)。当 Power 超过检测阈值时产生 "detection phase transition"。**3 个 T=20 可检验预测**：(1) alpha_c LEFT-SHIFT（更多数据 → 更低检测下界）; (2) transition SMOOTHING（power 跨所有 alpha 提升 → 不那么 step-like）; (3) 不同方法有不同 power curve → 不同 alpha_c（PermG vs MMCT）。**[RETRACTED D143] ~~TY=7/8 Smoking Gun~~**: Reviewer CRITICAL — s42 TY d_max=0→0/8 vs s43 d_max=2→7/8 完全由 d_max auto-selection 驱动 (df_resid=1 过拟合, chi2=5468)。TY=7/8 不可作为 Power Theory 验证。**Method-dependent α_c 理论仍成立**（spec curve 显示方法间 sensitivity 差异）但缺 T=11 直接实证——等 T=20 + 固定 d_max。PermG fdr_p gradient (s43 min=0.059, s42 min=0.091) 作为 sub-threshold evidence 仍有效（独立于 TY）。T=20 实验 RUNNING (t20_a050/a060/a075/a100 + t20_a045 待启) 验证预测(1)(2)(3)。Gu et al. 27	## Story Spine (D130: Discovery Paper)
28	
29	- **Problem**: Iterative training on model-generated data causes progressive model collapse, but the fundamental question — **at what contamination level does causal detection become possible?** — remains unanswered. Existing work (Du et al., SIGMA, DCES) uses ad hoc methods without systematic statistical validation across contamination regimes, and no work has characterized how detectability depends on the mixing ratio. Scheffer et al. (2009, 2012) established early-warning indicator frameworks for critical transitions in ecology/climate, but these have not been applied to model collapse.
30	
31	- **Discovery**: We discover a **detection phase transition** — a steep onset of causal detectability at alpha_c approx 0.476 (sigmoid R^2=0.969, k>=200, Delta-alpha approx 0.02; at T=10, steepness T-dependent per C2 Power Theory). Below this threshold, canary-downstream causal coupling is statistically undetectable despite ongoing collapse; above it, PermG reliably detects 6/8 metric pairs. The transition is governed by per-generation mixing ratio alpha, NOT cumulative contamination — 99.75% vs 99.90% cumulative yields 0/8 vs 6/8 detection.
32	
33	- **Mechanism**: We propose the S(alpha) x R(alpha) competition model explaining the non-monotonic detectability pattern. Signal strength S monotonically increases with alpha, but temporal resolution R drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time matches observation interval. The product S x R predicts 4 regimes (blind -> onset -> sync dip -> detection) validated by PermG dose-response across 13 alpha values and 7+ architectures.
34	
35	- **Tool**: Multi-method diagnostic toolkit (MMCT, 5 independent methods) enables the discovery. PermG achieves 0/24 null FPR. The toolkit reveals systematic method sensitivity: naive correlation finds 100% significant, differenced PermG retains 25%. MMCT is the discovery instrument, not the discovery itself.
36	
37	- **Implications**: Four-layer detection taxonomy for practitioners, early cessation protocol (58.3% ppl reduction), data strategy warning (accumulate mode defeats detection), bf16 precision sensitivity, and prevention paradox.
38	
39	- **Headline result**: "In iterative synthetic training, causal detection of collapse undergoes a steep onset at per-generation mixing ratio alpha_c approx 0.50 (sigmoid R^2=0.969). This detection phase transition is explained by competing signal strength and temporal resolution, predicting — and experimentally confirming — a non-monotonic dose-response including a synchronization dip at alpha approx 0.60."
40	
41	- **Title**: "A Detection Phase Transition in Iterative Model Collapse"

# Paper Framing — distrib_canary_collapse

## Target Venue
- Primary: **EMNLP 2026 Main Track** (D043, 用户指定)
- ARR cycle: June 2026 (deadline ~June 15, 待确认具体日期)
- 格式: ACL 系列模板 (acl.sty), 8 页正文 + unlimited appendix
- Note: ARR May cycle 已过；June cycle 对齐 EMNLP 2026 commitment deadline

## Narrative Structure (D130: Discovery Paper Reframe)

**主线**：Detection Phase Transition Discovery。我们发现 canary-downstream 因果检测能力在 α_c≈0.50 附近经历 steep onset (sigmoid R²=0.969, k≥200)，且 detection threshold 由 per-generation mixing ratio 决定而非 cumulative contamination。Multi-method 分析是发现这一现象的工具，不是贡献本身。
**四根支柱**：(1) Detection phase transition = C1 核心发现；(2) S×R 理论框架 + 5-regime 预测 = C2 机制解释；(3) Multi-method diagnostic toolkit (MMCT) = C3 方法贡献（降级为工具）；(4) Four-layer taxonomy + early cessation + data strategy = C4 实践贡献。
**Claim 呈现顺序**：C1 (phase transition discovery) 领衔 → C2 (theoretical framework) → C3 (multi-method toolkit) → C4 (practical applications)。

## Core Claims (D130: 4 Contributions)

> **Claim mapping (D130)**: D130 重组了贡献结构。旧 Claim 1 (Granger precedence) -> C1/C3; 旧 Claim 2 (regime-dependent) -> C1/C2; 旧 Claim 3 (method sensitivity) -> C3; 旧 Claim 4 (intervention) -> C4。下文 Key Narrative Constraints 中引用 "Claim 1/2/3/4" 仍指旧编号，按此映射解读。

**C1: Detection Phase Transition (核心发现)** — Canary-downstream 因果检测能力在 alpha_c approx 0.476 附近经历 steep onset (at T=10; steepness T-dependent per C2 Power Theory)。Sigmoid fit R^2=0.969, steepness k>=200, transition width Δα median=0.022 (95% CI [0.008, 0.060]; **C2: Theoretical Framework (机制解释)** — S(alpha) x R(alpha) 竞争模型: Detectability proportional to S(alpha) x R(alpha)。S = signal strength (monotonic increasing with alpha); R = temporal resolution (non-monotonic, drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time tau_relax(alpha) matches observation interval)。Predicts 4 regimes: (I) Blind zone alpha<0.45 — S too weak; (II) Onset alpha approx 0.45-0.50 — S crosses detection threshold; (III) Sync dip alpha approx 0.55-0.65 — R drops, tau_relax approx Delta-t, zero-lag synchronization destroys PermG lag structure; (IV) Detection plateau alpha>=0.70 — S dominates despite low R。Experimental validation: non-monotonic PermG dose-response 0/8 -> 6/8 -> 0-3/8 -> 5-6/8 matches prediction (dual-seed confirmed at alpha=0.60: s42=3/8, s43=0/8)。Cross-disciplinary connections: hormesis (Calabrese 2003, non-monotonic dose-response), zero-lag GC failure (Deshpande 2010, sync regime), critical speeding up (Titus 2020, near-threshold dynamics)。**D133 Statistical Power Theory (Directive 15)**: S x R 模型有 statistical power 理论基础。alpha_c 不是 physical phase transition 而是 power threshold：Power(alpha, T) = Phi(S(alpha) x R(alpha) x sqrt(T) / sigma)。当 Power 超过检测阈值时产生 "detection phase transition"。**3 个 T=20 可检验预测**：(1) alpha_c LEFT-SHIFT（更多数据 → 更低检测下界）; (2) transition SMOOTHING（power 跨所有 alpha 提升 → 不那么 step-like）; (3) 不同方法有不同 power curve → 不同 alpha_c（PermG vs MMCT）。**[RETRACTED D143] ~~TY=7/8 Smoking Gun~~**: Reviewer CRITICAL — s42 TY d_max=0→0/8 vs s43 d_max=2→7/8 完全由 d_max auto-selection 驱动 (df_resid=1 过拟合, chi2=5468)。TY=7/8 不可作为 Power Theory 验证。**Method-dependent α_c 理论仍成立**（spec curve 显示方法间 sensitivity 差异）但缺 T=11 直接实证——等 T=20 + 固定 d_max。PermG fdr_p gradient (s43 min=0.059, s42 min=0.091) 作为 sub-threshold evidence 仍有效（独立于 TY）。T=20 实验 RUNNING (t20_a050/a060/a075/a100 + t20_a045 待启) 验证预测(1)(2)(3)。Gu et al. (2025, NeurIPS Spotlight, arXiv:2505.18091) data mixing phase transitions 提供理论类比。

## Story Spine (D130: Discovery Paper)

- **Problem**: Iterative training on model-generated data causes progressive model collapse, but the fundamental question — **at what contamination level does causal detection become possible?** — remains unanswered. Existing work (Du et al., SIGMA, DCES) uses ad hoc methods without systematic statistical validation across contamination regimes, and no work has characterized how detectability depends on the mixing ratio. Scheffer et al. (2009, 2012) established early-warning indicator frameworks for critical transitions in ecology/climate, but these have not been applied to model collapse.

- **Discovery**: We discover a **detection phase transition** — a steep onset of causal detectability at alpha_c approx 0.476 (sigmoid R^2=0.969, k>=200, Delta-alpha approx 0.02; at T=10, steepness T-dependent per C2 Power Theory). Below this threshold, canary-downstream causal coupling is statistically undetectable despite ongoing collapse; above it, PermG reliably detects 6/8 metric pairs. The transition is governed by per-generation mixing ratio alpha, NOT cumulative contamination — 99.75% vs 99.90% cumulative yields 0/8 vs 6/8 detection.

- **Mechanism**: We propose the S(alpha) x R(alpha) competition model explaining the non-monotonic detectability pattern. Signal strength S monotonically increases with alpha, but temporal resolution R drops at alpha approx 0.60 when relaxation time matches observation interval. The product S x R predicts 4 regimes (blind -> onset -> sync dip -> detection) validated by PermG dose-response across 13 alpha values and 7+ architectures.

- **Tool**: Multi-method diagnostic toolkit (MMCT, 5 independent methods) enables the discovery. PermG achieves 0/24 null FPR. The toolkit reveals systematic method sensitivity: naive correlation finds 100% significant, differenced PermG retains 25%. MMCT is the discovery instrument, not the discovery itself.

- **Implications**: Four-layer detection taxonomy for practitioners, early cessation protocol (58.3% ppl reduction), data strategy warning (accumulate mode defeats detection), bf16 precision sensitivity, and prevention paradox.

- **Headline result**: "In iterative synthetic training, causal detection of collapse undergoes a steep onset at per-generation mixing ratio alpha_c approx 0.50 (sigmoid R^2=0.969). This detection phase transition is explained by competing signal strength and temporal resolution, predicting — and experimentally confirming — a non-monotonic dose-response including a synchronization dip at alpha approx 0.60."

- **Title**: "A Detection Phase Transition in Iterative Model Collapse"

- **Literature positioning**: Du et al. 是经验前辈但无统计检验框架; Scheffer et al. (2009/2012) 临界转变早期预警框架首次引入 model collapse; Gu et al. (2024, EMNLP, arXiv:2407.17467) data mixing; Gu et al. (2025, NeurIPS Spotlight, arXiv:2505.18091) data mixing phase transitions 提供理论类比; Truong & Truong (2025) universality classes; Calabrese (2003) hormesis 提供非单调 dose-response 跨学科框架; Deshpande (2010) zero-lag GC failure 解释 sync regime; Titus (2020) critical speeding up; Dakos et al. (2012) CSD methods。**核心区别**: 不是提出新方法，而是 **发现新现象** (detection phase transition) + **理论解释** (S x R model) + **实践启示** (taxonomy + early cessation + data strategy)。

## Key Narrative Constraints (from MVP + plan_003)

1. **不能 claim "canary predicts model collapse"** — 只能 claim "canary predicts diversity collapse"。token_entropy→perplexity 经差分检验确认为伪回归（0/4 seed, F≈0, p=0.99, D017），未差分时的"弱信号"完全由共享非平稳趋势驱动。论文措辞用"spurious association confirmed by first-differencing"，不再用"弱信号"
2. **ECE→perplexity 和 token_entropy→perplexity 均为伪信号 (D017)** — 差分后两者均 0/4 seed 显著。未差分时观察到的"方向相反"（token_entropy 领先 vs perplexity 领先 ECE）是共享趋势的不同表现形式。论文报告差分前后对比作为方法论教训，不再需要机制性解释
3. **effective_rank 和 self_bleu 作为 canary 失败** — 必须全量报告，不能只报正面结果
4. **distinct_3 必须放 supplementary，不能完全省略** — max_lag=7 下升为 SIGNIFICANT 但 lag_std>1.5（双峰：seed 42 总是 -5，其余 -1/-2），维持 D008 降级策略，主文聚焦 distinct_1/2。Supplementary 需给完整结果 + 解释 lag instability（高阶 n-gram diversity 对短序列随机变异更敏感）。distinct_3 的不稳定性本身支持 "predictability boundary" 主题——即使 diversity 维度内部也有可预测性梯度
5. **max_lag=7 确认核心 lead 无截断** — token_entropy→distinct_1 lag=-1（std=0.0）、ECE→distinct_2 lag=-1（std=0.0）在 max_lag=5/7 下完全一致。token_entropy→perplexity lag=-5 虽非截断伪影，但已确认为非平稳伪回归（D017）
6. **~~Dual-timescale 升级条件~~ — 已失效 (D017)** — perplexity 通道经差分确认为伪回归，即使 plan_006 T=20 也无法拯救伪信号。"Two distinct lead horizons" 升级路径关闭。plan_006 的价值重新定位为：(1) diversity lead 在更长序列中的稳定性，(2) TY power 改善观察，(3) 差分后 permutation Granger 在 T=20 下的表现
7. **ECE→perplexity "反向因果"已确认为伪信号 (D017)** — 差分后 ECE→perplexity 0/4 SIG。之前的 post-hoc mechanistic hypothesis 无需讨论。论文只需报告差分前后对比
8. **TY 在 N=11 下完全不可用于区分真/伪关联** — d_max sensitivity 分析证实：d_max=0 过度宽松（连 effective_rank 都通过），d_max=1 过度保守（连 token_entropy→distinct_1 都拒绝），adaptive 因 ADF 不稳定而跨 seed 震荡。论文**不能**用 TY 作为"正确答案"。**spurious_rate 必须双版本报告**：含 TY 75%（16 pair 中 12 仅 TY 判伪）、排除 TY 后 62.5%（16 pair 中 10 在 4 种非 TY 方法下一致）。ECE→distinct_2/3 被 TY 判伪但在其余 4 种方法全部 4/4 SIG——这本身是"方法选择改变分类"的例证（Claim 3 素材）
9. **ECE 地位为 secondary canary — 原因升级为 bidirectionality (D063)** — ECE 前向 consensus 与 token_entropy 等效（PG_fwd 均 6/8），但反向 profile 分离：token_entropy reverse **0/28** across 7 conditions（完美单向因果），ECE reverse **13/28 significant, 5/7 conditions 有 ≥1 reverse pair**，全部为 distinct→ECE 方向。ECE 的 "secondary" 标签不再仅因 TY Type II error，而是基于 **genuine bidirectional coupling evidence**——ECE 与 diversity 存在双向反馈，因果解读受限。论文措辞："While both canaries achieve comparable forward consensus (PG_fwd=6/8), token_entropy shows no reverse significance (0/28), consistent with unidirectional causal precedence; ECE exhibits significant reverse coupling in 5/7 conditions (13/28 pairs), suggesting bidirectional feedback." 这同时服务 Claim 3：单看前向 sig 两者等价，加入反向检验后分离——分析维度选择改变结论
10. **d_max sensitivity 曲线是论文的 key figure** — 三组 d_max（0/adaptive/1）× spurious rate 的变化是 Claim 3 的核心可视化，展示"方法选择如何改变结论"
11. **统计效力必须显式论证** — Dream 三档一致 CRITICAL：T=10 下 TY 的 DOF 严重不足。论文必须包含 bootstrap/permutation 验证 + plan_006 (T=20) 结果。所有 p-value 必须经 BH FDR 校正

42. **D098 Onset boundary 精确定位 α≈0.25–0.30，"sharp transition" 替代 "step function"** — a025_s42_fp32 5-method: PermG=0/8, K≥4=0/8, MMCT=0/8。但 token_entropy→distinct_1 pair PermG raw p=0.007, FDR p=0.053（差 0.003 未过 0.05 阈值）。**这不是"零信号"而是"检测极限边缘"**。结合 α=0.10（0/8 无 borderline）→ α=0.25（0/8 但 borderline 0.053）→ α=0.50（6/8），过渡是 sharp 但非 binary。**全文将 "step function" 替换为 "sharp phase transition"**——"step function" 暗示二值跳变，borderline p=0.053 面前不攻自破。**D110 精化：onset boundary [0.40, 0.50]**（a035=0/8, a040=0/8 完成后精化；原 [0.25, 0.30] 仅为 borderline 信号萌芽点，实际 transition 更晚）。α=0.25 borderline p=0.053 是"检测极限边缘"但从 0.25 到 0.40 全部 0/8，transition 起点在 0.40 之后。**D114 精化：a045 PermG=0/8（3/8 raw-sig 但 BH FDR 全灭 min=0.091），onset 从 [0.40, 0.50] 收窄到 [0.45, 0.50]**。5 个 α 值（0.25/0.30/0.35/0.40/0.45）全部 PermG=0/8。**D093 padding 混杂警告**：所有 α≤0.45 为 post-D093（right padding, gen0 d1=0.098），所有 α=0.50 为 pre-D093（left padding, gen0 d1=0.092），boundary 与 D093 变更完全重合。α=0.50 三 seed 一致 6/8 降低混杂概率但无法排除——`a050_postd093_s42_fp32` 已安排验证。如 post-D093 α=0.50 仍 PermG≥6/8 → onset [0.45, 0.50] 稳健；如 PermG=0/8 → onset 依赖 padding side，需全面重审。正文 Results 报告 borderline p=0.053 作为 transition sharpness 定量证据。**D106 更新：K≥4 不再是主叙事指标**（已由 PermG fwd 替代，见约束 #41）。K≥4(3σ) dose-response 仅供 supplementary 参考。推荐表述修正："The transition from undetectable to reliably detectable occurs sharply between α=0.40 and α=0.50, with a faint borderline signal (FDR-corrected p=0.053) first appearing at α=0.25 but no reliable detection until α=0.50"。**Padding cohort 注意**：a025_s42 为 post-D093（left-padding），gen_0 d1=0.098 vs pre-D093 实验 gen_0 d1=0.092。Drift 百分比跨 cohort 不可直接对比，dose-response 图应用绝对 Gen 10 值或同 cohort 内比较
43. **D105 threshold_onset 3σ power limitation** — `method_ablation._onset_gen` 修正为 3σ 后（D105/M028），threshold_onset 在 T=11 短序列下检出率大幅下降（多数实验 0-2/8）。根因：downstream metrics 在 11 代内很少超越 gen-0 baseline + 3×sigma，3σ 阈值过严。这导致 K≥4(3σ) 中位数仅 3/8（threshold_onset 贡献 ≈0-1 票）。**论文处理**：Table 7 主指标用 PermG fwd（不依赖 threshold_onset）+ K≥3(3σ)（容忍 threshold_onset 缺席）。threshold_onset 3σ power limitation 在 Method/Appendix 讨论，作为 Claim 3 方法敏感性的又一维度——阈值选择影响单方法检出率进而影响 consensus
44. **D106 GPT-2m bidirectional coupling (Discussion)** — GPT-2m s42/s43 reverse PermG 3-4/8 pairs 显著（downstream→canary 方向），暗示 GPT-2m 存在 bidirectional feedback 而非单向因果。与 ECE bidirectional coupling（约束 #9）类似但发生在不同 canary（token_entropy）上且为架构特异性。**论文处理**：Discussion 段落讨论架构差异如何影响因果方向性——GPT-2m 的 tied embeddings / 不同 attention pattern 可能导致不同 coupling pattern。不影响 forward consensus（仍 ≥6/8）但因果解读需 qualify。丰富 Claim 3：架构选择是影响 lead-lag 结论的又一维度
45. **D105 5method_leadlag.json naive_xcorr direction bug** — d102_rerun_8pair.py 中 naive_xcorr 方向过滤存在 sign reversal bug（`peak_lag > 0` 实为 downstream leads canary，与预期相反）。**论文只使用 unified_5method.json 的结果**，5method_leadlag.json 已废弃。所有已发布的 Table 7 数据均基于 unified_5method.json，不受此 bug 影响。代码仓库中 5method_leadlag.json 保留但标注 DEPRECATED
47. **D112 C4 域 collapse profile 质性不同 — perplexity-dominated + 逆单调 ppl** — C4 α=0.25: ppl +3617%, d1 -4.2%, eff_rank +112%。与 WikiText α=0.25（ppl -8.4%, d1 -36.7%）完全相反：WikiText diversity-dominated collapse，C4 perplexity-dominated collapse。C4 ppl 逆单调（低 α=0.25 ppl=892 > 高 α=0.50 ppl=728 > α=0.75 ppl=541）——更低污染反而更高困惑度，机制假说：低 α 保持多样性但破坏校准，高 α 坍缩到窄模式 ppl 反降。**论文影响**：(a) Cross-domain claim 从 "regime map generalizes" 转为 **"regime structure exists in both domains but collapse mode differs"**——更诚实也更有趣；(b) C4 下 canary→mauve 可能是唯一有效下游通道（mauve -52.1%, d1/d2/d3 几乎不动）；(c) Domain 选择是影响 collapse 机制的又一维度 → 丰富 Claim 3；(d) Discussion 必须显式讨论 C4 逆单调 ppl 模式。**MMCT 分析完成**：PermG=0/8 确认 blind zone。Direction-checked 后 K≥3=0/8（未校正 8/8 全来自 naive/diff/threshold 三个 FPR-prone 方法），diff_xcorr 全部 8 pair peak_lag<0（0/8 direction-checked）。ece→mauve PermG borderline（raw p=0.031, FDR p=0.094）但双向（rev raw p=0.028）→ 共同驱动非因果。Cross-domain onset: C4 ∈ (0.25, 0.50], WikiText ∈ [0.40, 0.50]——区间重叠，**无法 claim C4 onset 低于 WikiText**，论文报告为 "overlapping onset intervals"。Mauve 确认为跨域 bridge metric（C4 -52%, Wiki -42%），但 C4 n-gram diversity 极端 robust（d1 -4.2%）导致 PermG 无 power。**D111 全局审计（M030）**：三个 C4 实验 direction-checked 修正——c4_a050: K≥4 8/8→2/8, naive 8/8→4/8, diff 8/8→0/8；c4_a075: K≥4 8/8→**0/8**, naive 8/8→0/8, diff 8/8→0/8；PermG 不受影响（c4_a050=8/8, c4_a075=8/8）。**C4 diff_xcorr 系统性反向**：三个 C4 实验 24/24 个 diff pair 全部 peak_lag≤0（downstream leads canary），这是 C4 域特有现象，WikiText 不存在。论文 Discussion 报告为 "domain-dependent temporal structure"——C4 差分化后时间结构反转，MMCT 中 diff_xcorr 方法在 C4 上失效，进一步支撑 Claim 3 方法×域交互。**C4 s43 cross-seed 更新**：c4_a075_s43 PermG=8/8, K≥3=8/8; c4_a050_s43 PermG=8/8, K≥3=3/8。PermG 跨 seed 完美稳定（8/8 both seeds），但 **K≥3 方法组成完全翻转**：s42 K≥3 靠 threshold+TY+PermG 驱动（naive=0, diff=0），s43 靠 naive+diff+PermG 驱动（threshold=0, TY=1）。D111 direction check 效应跨 seed 反转——s42 的 naive/diff 全被方向过滤杀掉，s43 全部通过。**论文影响**：consensus 数值稳定性可能掩盖底层 method composition 不稳定性——K≥3 作为"共识强度"需附带方法组成分解，否则审稿人质疑 robustness。这是 Claim 3 的额外维度：即使 consensus metric 看似稳健，driving methods 也可能不稳健。**C4 PermG_rev 不对称性**：c4_a050_s42 PermG_rev=7/8（fwd=8/8，近对称双向耦合），但 c4_a050_s43 rev=1/8, c4_a075_s42 rev=0/8, c4_a075_s43 rev=0/8（3/4 条件清晰单向）。c4_a050_s42 的近对称性意味着该条件下 Granger 因果几乎对称——不支持"canary leads downstream"叙事。论文**必须报告 PermG_rev**，至少在 C4 表格中。**论文策略**：C4 域以 PermG_fwd 为主指标（4/4=8/8 完全 robust），K≥3 仅在 WikiText 主轴报告（C4 K≥3 method composition 完全 seed-dependent：s42≈0/8 vs s43=8/8，不 robust）
48. **D115+D117 K≥4 部分恢复 — MMCT 恢复 5 方法框架** — D115 "K≥4 全面归零" 基于 M035 bug（direction filter `peak_lag > 0` 为反向因果）。M035 修正后 K≥4 在检出区恢复至 3-6/8，但 D105 threshold_onset 3σ/T=11 power limitation 独立于 M035，threshold 投票仍 0-2/8，限制 K≥4 上限。K≥4 维持 supplementary 定位（非 appendix-only）。**MMCT 恢复为 5 方法共识框架**：naive_fwd + diff_fwd + threshold_onset + PermG + TY。K≥3 由 {PermG + naive_fwd + diff_fwd} 或 {PermG + threshold + TY} 组合驱动，≥5/8 in 11/13 experiments。Dose-response 和 heatmap figures 需用 M035-corrected direction data 重生成
49. **[REVERTED by D117] D116 K≥3 崩溃为 M035 bug artifact** — D116 "K_max=2, K≥3 不可能" 完全由 M035 sign reversal bug 导致（direction filter `peak_lag > 0` 实为反向因果）。修正后 K≥3 ≥5/8 in 11/13 experiments（GPT-2m 6/8, OPT 5-6/8, Padding 6/8, C4 6-7/8 等）。**Table 7 恢复 PermG fwd + K≥3(3σ) 双指标**。MMCT 叙事恢复为 "多方法共识框架验证 lead-lag"——5 方法中 3+ 方法在绝大多数实验中一致检出前向因果。Claim 3 方法敏感性仍有充分独立证据：差分翻转 perplexity 通道（D017）、TY d_max sensitivity（约束 #8）、regime-dependent validity（Claim 2）、D105 threshold power limitation
46. **D109+D117 SmolLM3-3B canary sensitivity — token_entropy Granger 失效** — SmolLM3-3B s42: PermG 3/8, **K≥3=3/8**（M035 修正后恢复；D116 时 0/8 为 bug artifact）, K≥4=0/8。仅 ECE→d1/d2/d3 有 PermG 检出（3/8），token_entropy→downstream 全部 PermG=0/4。M035 修正后 ECE pairs 的 naive_fwd/diff_fwd 恢复，ECE pairs 达到 K=3（PermG + naive_fwd + diff_fwd），但 token_entropy pairs 仍因非单调振荡破坏 Granger 而 K≤2。根因不变：(a) token_entropy 非单调振荡破坏 Granger 检测；(b) ECE gen_1 即饱和后几乎不变，限制 Granger power。**论文处理**：(a) SmolLM3 是 canary 指标选择影响检测力的极端实例——PermG 弱(3/8)且仅 ECE pairs 有效；(b) 丰富 Claim 3：canary 指标选择是影响检测结论的关键维度；(c) Table 7 行 SmolLM3 PermG=3/8, K≥3=3/8 诚实报告（K≥3 与 PermG 完全重合 = ECE pairs 有跨方法共识，entropy pairs 无）；(d) 跨架构 PermG claim 10/12，SmolLM3 为 canary-specific 例外。**SmolLM3 s43 RUNNING** — 验证 canary 分裂 pattern 是否 cross-seed 稳健
50. **M037 threshold_onset 2σ/3σ 一致性审计（进行中）** — Reviewer 发现部分实验 threshold_onset 使用 2σ（膨胀到 8/8），D105 后的实验使用 3σ（多数 0-2/8）。K≥3 作为 5 方法共识投票，threshold 贡献 1 票，2σ vs 3σ 导致 K≥3 跨实验不可比。**影响范围**：(a) dose-response α-sweep K≥3 值（batch_analysis.py 可能未更新到 3σ）；(b) 部分 Table 7 实验的 K≥3 可能虚高；(c) "10-11/13 K≥3 ≥5/8" claim 待 3σ 统一审计后确认。**PermG 不受影响**（不依赖 threshold_onset，且是唯一跨脚本一致的方法）。**M037 扩展发现**：batch_analysis.py 与 run_5method.py 在同一实验上 TY 差异巨大（α=0.75 s43: 1/8 vs 6/8）、diff 也不一致（8/8 vs 6/8），仅 PermG 两套脚本完全一致。这意味着 K≥3 受三重不确定性影响：(a) threshold 2σ/3σ, (b) TY 实现差异, (c) diff 实现差异。**Paper Agent 约束升级**：dose-response 图表**只能用 PermG 列**，K≥3 完全冻结直到统一脚本审计完成。M037 审计已完成，TY/diff root cause 调查中。检出区 PermG 从 "≥6/8" 更正为 "5-6/8"（α=0.75 s42=6/8, s43=5/8，差异来自 te→d1 边界 FDR p=0.056）
51. **CSD-consistent pattern = Discussion only (D138→D142)** — Full-range dissociation 定性成立 (canary τ=0.79 vs downstream τ=0.03)，但 blind zone 多重校正后仅 2/10 存活 + 缺 surrogate test + T=11 onset jump 在噪声内。措辞: "CSD-consistent pattern" 非 "confirms CSD"。不进 Results，仅 Discussion suggestive evidence。T=20 重跑后可能升级
52. **[RETRACTED D143] TY=7/8 = d_max artifact** — s42 d_max=0→TY=0/8 vs s43 d_max=2→TY=7/8, 完全由 auto ADF 在 T=11 下不稳定驱动 (df_resid=1 过拟合)。不可作为 Power Theory evidence。Method-dependent α_c 理论保留但缺 T=11 实证, 等 T=20。"steep onset" 替代 "near-discontinuous" 仍有效 (基于 PermG fdr_p 独立于 TY)。fdr_p (s42: 0.091, s43: 0.059) 仍须披露
53. **Skip α=0.47/0.48 (D140)** — T=20 验证 Power Theory 三预测优先于 fine α resolution。α_c 是 method-dependent 统计量，精确定位 PermG α_c 不是科学重点
54. **"Power Theory" = standard power analysis applied to S×R, not novel theory (D146)** — C2 的 √T scaling 是标准统计功效分析（任何教材都有），novelty 在于 S(α)×R(α) 竞争框架应用于 model collapse detection，不在于 power scaling 本身。论文措辞必须："We apply standard statistical power scaling to the PermG test statistic under the S×R framework" 而非暗示 √T scaling 是本文发现。审稿人会直接指出这只是 standard power analysis — 先发制人定位清楚
55. **Predict-then-verify 叙事修正 (D146→D147 bootstrap update)** — Bootstrap N=10000 结果改变 falsifiability 格局。α_c bootstrap CI=[0.425, 0.558] 横跨 transition，导致：(a) **α=0.45/0.50 CI=[0,7]，几乎不可证伪**——transition 两侧预测天然不可靠，任何结果都 "consistent"；(b) **α≥0.75/1.00 CI=[6,8]，是 clean falsifiable tests**——predicted 7/8, 若实际 <6/8 则 √T scaling 被证伪。论文叙事：α≥0.75 是 key falsifiable predictions；α=0.45 是 key INFORMATIVE test（point prediction 0/8, 但 wide CI 意味着结果无论如何都能约束 α_c 位置）；α=0.50 inherently uncertain at transition。禁止说 α=0.45 是 "唯一可证伪预测"（旧 D146 措辞已废弃）。C2 predict-then-verify 整体定位："consistency with power scaling at α≥0.75 + honest uncertainty quantification at onset boundary"
56. **α_c 位置不确定性 ≠ transition 陡峭度 (D147→D149 quantified)** — α_c CI=[0.425, 0.558]（位置不确定性 ±0.07）与 Δα（过渡宽度/陡峭度）是独立概念。D149 bootstrap 定量：Δα median=0.022, 95% CI [0.008, 0.060]；α_c CI width 0.133 是 Δα 的 6×。Fisher exact 0/64 vs 18/32 (p=3.45×10⁻¹¹, D148-corrected α=0.60=0/8) 提供 model-free 跳变证据。论文必须显式区分："transition is sharp (Δα≈0.02) but its exact position is uncertain (α_c CI=[0.43, 0.56]) due to sparse 12-point α grid"。Δp(0.50-0.45) median=0.43, CI [0.00, 0.80]——CI 宽因 α_c uncertainty 横跨 0.45-0.55，非 transition 不存在
